info.name: Sygnal — UC1 Upward Fever Referral (DIGIT HCM → ComEMR)
info.description:
### Quick-start: environment setup

1. Import this use case's **`*_Dev.postman_environment.json`** (in the same
   `reference-flows/` folder) into Postman (Environments → Import). Each use case
   ships a self-contained environment — Postman allows only one active environment
   at a time, so per-UC envs avoid one ever-growing shared file.
2. Select that environment from the picker.
3. Set `bpp_uri`, `bap_uri`, and `auth_token` for your sandbox. `bpp_uri` is the target
   base URL and switches by transaction (ComEMR for T1, HCM for UC3, CARE for UC4-T2).
4. `network_id` is `example.net/health` (STUB) — confirm with the registry team.
5. Subscriber IDs (`hcm_np_id`, `comemr_np_id`, `care_np_id`) and all keys are STUBBED.

**Envelope note:** `context.version` is `2.0.0` — the Beckn *core message* version (a
const in beckn.yaml). The domain schema packs (HealthReferral / ServiceCoordination)
are v2.1; that shows up in the `@context` URLs, not the envelope.

## Sygnal — UC1 · Upward Fever Referral (DIGIT HCM → ComEMR)

**Scenario:** A Hard-to-Reach CHW on an ITN bednet campaign observes fever (RDT+ malaria)
in a child. DIGIT HCM refers the child into ComEMR, which routes internally to a
clinical-mode CHW (iCCM → RDT → treatment → Day-3 / Day-7 follow-up) and, if fever
persists, escalates to the PHU.

**Roles:** BAP = DIGIT HCM (referrer). BPP = ComEMR (care coordinator **and** provider —
the PHU runs ComEMR in this deployment).

**Topology:** Single on-network hop. The Day-3 PHU escalation is ComEMR-internal, modelled
as the referral's downstream target via `targetBookingRef` (an opaque internal ref — **not**
a new referral and **not** an on-network T2). The separate-system case is UC4.

**Directed:** discover is skipped — ComEMR is the known clinical coordinator for the geography.

**Payload:** `HealthReferral` (T1) in `contract.contractAttributes`. Consent **class A**
(CHW-mediated; `mediatorCredentialRef` set). Coded `targetCriteria`. Lifecycle:
ACTIVE → ATTENDED → BOOKING_CONFIRMED (escalation) → OUTCOME_RECEIVED → CLOSED.

**Deviation:** in-band `deviation` (coded + note) shown on an update in the Deviation folder,
using the standard `hrf:DeviationReasonCode` member `NO_SHOW`.

### CodedValue / schema notes
- `targetCriteria.specialty` / `subSpecialty` use codes (`PAEDIATRICS`, `ICCM`) that are **not**
  in the `hrf:Specialty` / `hrf:SubSpecialty` vocab (which lists CARDIOLOGY, PULMONOLOGY, etc.).
  These are **self-authored** members via a `@context` override — a vocabulary gap to close.
- No `consideration` block: these are public-health coordination flows with no fee (a deliberate
  divergence from the OHSN commercial referral house style).

item.name: Referral Coordination  (BAP DIGIT HCM → BPP ComEMR)
item.description: Directed upward referral. Single on-network hop — ComEMR is both coordinator and provider (PHU runs ComEMR).

request.description: HCM opens a referral against ComEMR's coordination capability. Directed — discover skipped (ComEMR is the known clinical coordinator for the geography).
ComEMR accepts the coordination request; BPP assigns the contract id (= Referral ID).
HCM confirms binding intent; full participant detail attached.
ComEMR echoes the draft referral back.
HCM confirms the referral. Carries consent (class A, CHW-mediated), referral-note pointer, notification roster.
ComEMR accepts; lifecycleState ACTIVE. coordinationId is the Referral ID. ComEMR now routes internally to a clinical-mode CHW (iCCM, RDT+, treatment).
ComEMR reports ACTIVE — clinical CHW assigned, treatment underway.
ComEMR reports the child attended clinical care (iCCM assessment + RDT + treatment).

Day-3 fever persists → ComEMR escalates to the PHU. Because the PHU runs ComEMR here, this is INTERNAL — modelled as the referral's downstream target via targetBookingRef (an opaque ComEMR-internal ref, NOT an on-network T2). See UC4 for the separate-system (CARE) case.
Day-7 follow-up: child recovered. Outcome note handed back to HCM (records-layer data stays off-network; only the pointer travels).
